# Infrastructure Checklist: Foundation & Scaffolding

**Purpose**: Validate that infrastructure, service provisioning, readiness/health, secrets, and start-up/stop requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable.
**Created**: 2026-09-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the identities of all baseline services (user interface, API, database, monitoring) fully enumerated in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the single-command start/stop behavior for all services specified as a requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the readiness/health contract requirement explicitly defined for the local platform components? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the external AI dependency status reporting requirement (separate from local readiness) documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the requirement to keep all secrets out of source control explicitly stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Are all required runtime configuration values (database connection, AI service key, session secret, monitoring keys) enumerated in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the meaning of the readiness "READY / UP" status defined unambiguously (which components must be available)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the behavior when the external AI service is unreachable specified without ambiguity (overall readiness not failed)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the required configuration fields in the non-committed template specified by name and purpose? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the "single documented command" for starting all services precisely identified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Is the readiness semantics consistent across the spec, the health contract, and the success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, contracts/api-contracts.md]
- [ ] CHK012 Do the start-up behavior requirements align with the health/readiness verification criteria in the quickstart guide? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001/FR-002, quickstart.md]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the scope boundary (this phase only provisions, does not implement ingestion/retrieval/generation) consistent across all sections? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the service identities in FR-001 consistent with the documented service inventory? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, plan.md]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Is each infrastructure success criterion (all services run, readiness returns READY/UP, migrations apply cleanly, CI passes) independently measurable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001..SC-005]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the readiness acceptance outcome objectively verifiable without implementation details? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the operator time-to-healthy-baseline criterion quantified with a specific time bound? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for the alternating scenario where the external AI provider is down but local components are healthy? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK019 Are startup, healthy-running, and shutdown flows all covered by requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for validating that every baseline service is running and healthy? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001/FR-002]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Is the requirement for behavior when required secrets are missing at startup specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the requirement for behavior when the database is unreachable at startup defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the requirement for surfacing a partially failed startup to operators specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the requirement for behavior when the external AI service is unreachable while local services are healthy explicitly addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK025 Is the readiness/health availability verification (single command → all services healthy) expressed as a measurable criterion? [NFR, Spec §FR-001, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the secrets hygiene requirement (never committed, provided via non-committed template) stated as a non-functional constraint? [NFR, Security, Spec §FR-005, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the container-runtime prerequisite documented as a dependency requirement? [NFR, Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 Is the dependency on an operational container runtime explicitly documented? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the dependency on a fresh or disposable database for migration validation documented? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the assumption that production deployment is out of scope for this phase validated and recorded? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK031 Are there any unresolved ambiguous terms (e.g., "healthy", "available") in the infrastructure requirements that lack quantification? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001/FR-002]
- [ ] CHK032 Are there conflicts between the readiness definition (local only) and any later-phase expectation that readiness implies full AI availability? [Conflict, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK033 Is it clear whether readiness checks database availability as part of the local-platform readiness? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, contracts/api-contracts.md]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
